files.review: Replaced 2205 lines of synthetic file changes, click/retry/clear assertions, copied transport results and accessibility checks with one direct React adapter lifecycle. Seed the real attachment coordinator with an already confirmed capture; actual control unmount/remount preserves ownership, and a supplied empty answer schedules the real HTTP DELETE without inventing an answer edit. No fake DOM gestures, canvas geometry or wrapper-stage mocks remain. Native attachment and FormScreen peers prove real file selection, upload bytes, confirmed answer publication and native controls; attachmentClient/attachmentHttp and controller migration owners retain queue, authority, retry and retarget rules.

Replaced 1426 lines of invented pointer geometry, drawing, clear/undo gestures and mocked pixels with three React encoder-lifetime adapter cases. Seed real retained ink programmatically; control only the native toBlob callback boundary, proving old-entry rejection, abandoned-encoding/remount resumption and null-encoding submission refusal. Real queue/barrier cleanup remains owned and timers are cancelled on teardown. Existing native attachment journey owns actual pointer drawing, PNG bytes/pixels, resizing, clear and undo.

Removed static insertion-row projection restatement already owned by rowModel. Kept only actual doc-store subscription, unrelated-mutation reference stability and collapse-prop dependency updates. Mutations apply to admitted documents through the real store; no browser interaction claims.

Removed 3979-line synthetic DOM workflow suite. Pure orderedCaseSelection, menuProjection, display-condition/search evaluation and runtime search owners prove state decisions; useCaseDataBinding retains actual resource/scope/reload binding. Native preview-cases peer proves independent cell actions, responsive card/detail geometry, paginated selection order, real review dialog, rejection of a held old-Project validation response and ordered continuation despite reversed transport row order. Existing authenticated case-change/search-first/grouped-tile/after-submit journeys prove application composition. No fake click, focus, geometry or substring workflow is counted as browser evidence.

Removed 4088-line synthetic DOM workflow suite and copied action/error arms. Moved its genuine created-child receipt projection unchanged into existing afterSubmitRouting production owner and tested it directly. Existing FormEngine, controller async/snapshot, attachment coordinator, action/Postgres submission and form-link/routing owners remain authoritative. Added actual FormScreen/provider/controller native journey for required-field focus, real file upload barrier, disabled form while queued, paired submission digest/ref payload, error/Clear entry rotation, same-Project answer preservation and automatic changed-Project answer/entry teardown. Application native repeats and authenticated after-submit/case-change journeys cover structure and workflow composition. Fixture never reenacts a Project remount.

Removed 1116 lines of synthetic typing/calendar/dialog events, widget dispatch and copied validation results. The existing native search peer now binds the real useSearchInputRunState owner and proves narrow/wide calendar geometry, incomplete-range validation, preserving the other date bound and complete submitted values. A second native journey controls only camera/detector APIs while using actual MediaStream tracks and native dialog/input interactions: late camera permission after cancellation, ordinary cancel and successful detection all end every track, and detected code reaches the actual submitted search. Domain date-range/search validation and new searchRunState tests own business rules.

Removed four provider smoke/instance/passthrough tests. Retained only React-specific initialization before child effects, warm identity binding, Strict Mode runtime replay, unavailable-persona controller binding and confirmed Project/app/authority lifetime. These operate actual controller/session stores and do not pretend to prove browser navigation.

Reassessed all 105 lines. Retained a narrow positive/negative React commit adapter pair: the same loading snapshot mutates the controller after a committed layout phase but not when a descendant throws and React abandons that render. Controlled resource/controller boundaries intentionally isolate commit timing; SQL/snapshot contents and browser visibility are not claimed.

Removed eight thin curry, typed-error passthrough and no-provider smoke tests. Retained 21 direct React resource-lifetime cases against actual session/invalidation/reload owners: synchronous old-scope masking, delayed-response retirement, page/rule dependency identity, same-query dedupe, persona/revision/parent population changes and mutation invalidation. Controlled Server Action promises are the explicit transport boundary; no fake DOM interactions or SQL claims.

Removed viewer argument passthrough and fixed-copy restatements. Kept only six direct request lifetime adapters: Project refresh, revocation, app change, unmount, newest response wins and refusing a send during refresh. Actual session store changes and owned deferred transport operations distinguish stale continuations; no browser gestures.

Reassessed the complete launch hook and 272-line suite. Its direct callbacks exercise actual admitted doc/session state and save-barrier/transport promises: route expiry, exact target installation, document generation and scope refusal, request settlement. This is a narrow asynchronous React adapter contract, with no DOM event fabrication. Native deep-link and Shell journeys separately own routing/UI evidence.

Moved search draft/submission/reconciliation rules into the production searchRunState owner and replaced 382-line hook business suite with two React adapter checks: stable submitted identity plus immediate scope masking; latest prospective hidden-value resolver after a session-only update while standing submitted values remain frozen. The latter catches and fixes the preexisting stale current.resolveHidden callback; the hook now exposes desired.resolveHidden. Six direct Node state cases cover default/edit/clear/scope reconciliation, explicit blank submits, forged hidden values versus restored searches, widget incompatibility/final-prompt removal, hidden rename/removal and fresh per-submit time.

Supplement to the previously fully reviewed pure routing owner: moved FormScreen created-child receipt projection here unchanged. Direct 2-child x 2-parent expectations preserve authored index/parent mapping; added incomplete and duplicate receipt refusals before routing. Existing routing and menu context tests remain unchanged. This is a later pass over an already counted baseline file, not a new baseline completion.

bugs.finding: A session-only or lookup-only change can preserve authored revision, leaving current.resolveHidden captured against an obsolete context. Prospective Search validation uses that callback although submit already resolves desired inputs.
bugs.fix: Return desired.resolveHidden while preserving stored submittedHidden and stable submitted map until a new Search. Direct React discriminator changes worker only and observes new prospective value alongside frozen previous search.
